title: Senior Advisor, Country Programs (Brazil)
description:
The Senior Advisor is the primary responsible executive for the success of the Alliance to End Plastic Waste (AEPW) program in-country. This role is accountable for delivering the full scope of the country program in alignment with AEPW Strategy 2030, ensuring that projects are designed and executed as part of a system-change agenda rather than isolated interventions. The Senior Advisor manages all in-country stakeholders—including government entities, DFIs, industry partners, and implementing organizations—and oversees AEPW staff, consultants, and contractors to ensure programs are delivered safely, efficiently, compliantly, and with measurable impact.


The Senior Advisor is both a strategic representative of AEPW to external stakeholders and an operational manager ensuring contract compliance, impact reporting, and staff performance.


Key Responsibilities


1. Program Strategy & Alignment

  • Develop, maintain, and execute a comprehensive country strategy aligned with AEPW’s global Strategy 2030.
  • Ensure that 80–90% of projects drive system-level transformation (e.G., integrated waste infrastructure, EPR alignment, circular economy enablers) with the remaining 10–20% focused on pilots for learning, impact generation, or stakeholder engagement.
  • Identify opportunities for replication and scaling across the country and region.
  • Anticipate regulatory, political, and market shifts that may affect the program;
    adapt strategy proactively


2. Stakeholder Engagement & Representation

  • Work very closely with AEPW Members, and facilitate all PAG, pre-PAG, and Member engagement relative to the Country Program Implementation.
  • Serve as AEPW’s senior representative in-country, maintaining strong relationships with: a) Local and national government ministries, regulators, and municipalities;
    b) DFIs and co-funding partners active in waste and circular economy infrastructure;
    c) Industry stakeholders including brands, recyclers, and waste operators;
    and d) Civil society groups, NGOs, and academic institutions.
  • Represent AEPW in policy dialogues, conferences, and industry roundtables, ensuring the organization is seen as a co-creator of solutions.
  • Work with the Central PA team to ensure alignment of government relations.
  • Act as primary escalation point for all stakeholder issues arising within the program.


3. Project Development & Execution Oversight

  • Guide development of new projects to ensure alignment with program objectives and system-change principles.
  • Review and approve project proposals prior to submission to the Portfolio Management Committee / Governing Council.
  • Oversee in-country execution teams and implementing partners to ensure adherence to AEPW’s global standards.
  • Ensure strict compliance with AEPW’s E2E Program Implementation process, safeguard requirements, and contractual obligations.
  • Conduct regular site visits, milestone reviews, and partner performance evaluations.
  • Collaborate with Circular Solutions Centre to ensure technical due diligence and innovation pilots are rigorously assessed.


4. Contract Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure all projects adhere to the terms of their contracts, including milestones, disbursement conditions, reporting obligations, and safeguard actions.
  • Work closely with Central Legal / Contracts to enforce compliance and resolve disputes.
  • Maintain a country-level risk register and escalate risks (financial, operational, reputational, HSE) to the Central Risk team.
  • Ensure world-class HSE standards are embedded in all project activities, in line with AEPW expectations and international best practices.


5. Financial Structuring & Oversight

  • Collaborate with Impact Finance to co-structure deals with DFIs, private investors, and corporate co-funders.
  • Monitor financial performance of all projects (grants, loans, blended finance) including repayment obligations.
  • Ensure transparent and timely financial reporting for donors, DFIs, and AEPW central finance.


6. Impact Measurement & Reporting

  • Ensure all projects deliver on AEPW’s impact metrics: plastic waste collected, sorted, and valorized;
    access to waste management;
    jobs created;
    safety performance, etc..
  • Work with Global Support to provide accurate and timely reporting for impact metrics, Portfolio Management Committee / Governing council, donor, and member communications.
  • Facilitate external audits, evaluations, and lessons-learned reviews.


7. People Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, mentor, and manage all AEPW employees and consultants in-country.
  • Ensure teams operate safely, efficiently, and productively with clear accountability.
  • Foster a culture of compliance, transparency, and impact delivery.
  • Build local capacity by coaching and developing staff and ensuring knowledge transfer across teams.
  • Ensure strong collaboration across functions (Execution, CSC, Support, Finance, Legal, PA and Strategy/Planning).


Requirements / Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in business, engineering, public policy, or a related field.
  • Minimum 20+ years’ experience in senior leadership roles within infrastructure, development, or circular economy sectors.
  • Proven experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with government, DFIs, corporates, and NGOs.
  • Strong contract management, compliance, and risk oversight skills.
  • Demonstrated financial acumen in structuring and monitoring large-scale projects.
  • Experience working in international development, public-private partnerships, or donor-funded projects highly preferred.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and diplomatic skills.
  • High integrity, resilience under pressure, and ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on operational management.

title: Associate Teacher, Primary Division
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.


Job Description


Deep Collaboration, Constant Evolution

Collaboration here isn't a buzzword: it's woven into everything we do. At Avenues, no one teaches on an island. Substantial time to collaborate is embedded into the schedule. Teacher teams, across multiple disciplines, design learning experiences together for a whole grade level. This intensity of collaboration is challenging as well as exciting: we're always evolving, learning from each other and seeking to improve.


Language Immersion

Avenues students will graduate fluent in a second language and at ease beyond their borders. To this end, in grades N-1 students will be in a full English immersion program and from grades 2-5, Portuguese will take on a prominent place in the classroom.

As an Avenues Associate Teacher, you will:

  • Support lead teachers to develop and teach curriculum across multiple subjects that engages all learners in meaningful, challenging work that cultivates 21st-century skills
  • Help ensure that all students achieve key learning outcomes for the grade level, targeting instruction thoughtfully to address individual needs
  • Build a robust learning atmosphere that leads students to value being at school and feel part of a rigorous but joyful learning community
  • Collaborate intensively and daily with colleagues to continually improve student learning and school culture
  • Participate actively in ongoing, intensive professional learning

*Please note that this is a temporary position to cover a maternity leave.*


Qualifications

  • Student teaching, teacher training or equivalent experience with children ages 3-8
  • Deep dedication to learning and developing the craft of teaching
  • Highly effective collaborator, eager to listen deeply, contribute to a team and achieve goals together
  • Very resourceful and adaptive, eager to embrace constant change, growth and learning
  • Bachelor’s degree required, master’s degree preferred


Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

title: Senior Business Development Consultant
description:
dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, empowering businesses everywhere to compete and thrive in the modern data-driven economy. We always put the Customer First.

Our mission: to enable businesses to grow and reimagine themselves by becoming advocates and champions for their Customers. With deep heritage and expertise in retail – one of the world’s most competitive markets, with a deluge of multi-dimensional data – dunnhumby today enables businesses all over the world, across industries, to be Customer First.

dunnhumby employs nearly 2,500 experts in offices throughout Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas working for transformative, iconic brands such as Tesco, Coca-Cola, Meijer, Procter & Gamble and Metro.


We’re looking for a Senior Business Development Consultant who expects more from their career. It’s a chance to become a trusted partner to key clients, building relationships to define and deliver our company goals. It’s an opportunity to deliver dunnhumby’s growth strategy through developing new engagements with grocery retailers, CPG's and other prospects across the region.

Joining our new business team, you will leverage your strong network to trigger new business opportunities and win sales, pitching our unique and innovative set of customer-first solutions designed for grocery retailers: customer loyalty, customer engagement, category management, price and promotions, data and media monetization. You will manage the new business cycle through prospecting, qualification, needs analysis, stakeholder mapping, pitching and negotiation. Once contracts are won, you will roll out the optimum operating model to get client engagement up and running to execute plans. You will work with a range of stakeholders, Products specialists, finance and legal, as well as senior members within client organizations.

What we expect from you:

  • Successful track record, 5+ years, of delivering new business targets in a tech / consulting environment
  • A strong network of senior contacts within grocery retailers and CPG's (plus)
  • Building great relationships with new client stakeholders, establishing trust and becoming a true partner
  • Consultative approach to selling, identifying needs and selling customer-first solutions
  • Great collaboration with colleagues


What You Can Expect From Us

We won’t just meet your expectations. We’ll defy them. So you’ll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you’d expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.

You’ll also benefit from an investment in cutting-edge technology that reflects our global ambition. But with a nimble, small-business feel that gives you the freedom to play, experiment and learn.

And we don’t just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. Please let us know how we can make this process work best for you.

Our approach to Flexible Working

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.

We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.

For further information about how we collect and use your personal information please see our Privacy Notice which can be found (here)

title: Legal Contract Lawyer/ Brazil / Vbet
description:
About the Company

VBET is an award-winning sports betting and gaming operator with 20 years of experience in the industry powered in-house by BetConstruct. We have shifted from a start-up to an extensive international company holding over 10 licenses and operating in over 120 countries. VBET’s mission is to give our customers the best betting and gaming experience in a safe and secure environment.


About the Role

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Contract Manager (Legal) to take full ownership of our third-party vendor contracts. This operational role requires a pragmatic, hands-on professional who can quickly standardize our contracting process and mitigate commercial risks.

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Type: Full-time (on-site)

Reports to: Local CEO, Global Head of Legal Department


Key Responsibilities

  • Contract Standardization: Assess the current state of vendor agreements (approx. 50-60 external contractors) and develop several streamlined, legally sound contract templates for routine operational and marketing expenditures
  • Template Ownership: Create and manage a library of standardized contract documents, ensuring ease of use for internal departments (e.G., Marketing, Operations) to significantly reduce time-to-signature
  • Contract Lifecycle Management: Manage the end-to-end lifecycle for new and existing contracts, including drafting, execution, revisions, amendments, and renewals
  • Risk Mitigation: Conduct initial risk assessments on existing and proposed contracts, identifying crucial clauses and necessary adjustments before execution
  • Cross-Functional Support: Act as the primary point of contact for internal teams (especially Marketing) to provide guidance on contract preparation and compliance
  • Internal Alignment: Ensure all regional contract needs and changes are aligned with the new directorate structure being established in each territory
  • Legal Collaboration: Collaborate with the centralized legal team for review of complex international agreements and high-risk contracts


✅ Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Proven experience (3+ years) as a Contract Manager, Commercial Manager, Lawyer, Legal Counsel or similar role focused on high-volume contract administration
  • Experience working within the iGaming or betting sector is highly preferred
  • Strong, demonstrable knowledge and hands-on experience in contract management, drafting, and interpretation
  • Proven ability to implement new processes and templates that improve efficiency and significantly speed up internal workflows
  • Comfortable working autonomously and serving as the primary commercial/contractual expert within the local team
  • Fluent English and Brazilian Portuguese are mandatory

  • Actively manage the sales process, including positioning, presentation/demonstration of product, and closing warm leads generated by marketing and sales development

A inovação tecnológica aliada à qualidade dos produtos são os valores buscados diariamente na GMReis para que a expectativa dos clientes, médicos e pacientes, seja plenamente atendida com segurança e eficácia.

title: Information Technology Support Engineer
description:
Job Title: IT Support Engineer (Short-Term Project)


Project Duration:

This is a 2-day onsite job activity


Scope of Work:

The selected Engineer/Consultant/Technician will be responsible for the deployment and installation of Microsoft IoT sensors at the client site. The scope of work includes:


1. Provide an efficient workforce for the project.

2. Technician/Consultant/Engineer must wear PPE, including safety glasses, safety shoes, helmet, and earplugs, if required at the site. These will be provided by the End-Customer.

3. Follow local health and safety codes, adhering to any guidelines provided at the site.

4. Wear site-appropriate clothing that does not interfere with work, such as avoiding loose garments.

5. Complete local safety training or other mandatory requirements before starting work. 6. Bring the necessary tools to complete tasks.

7. Perform all work in the presence of the Client’s stakeholders.

8. Review the site readiness for deployment, including checking rack and cabling availability.

9. With local supervisor approval, take photographs of the rack and network setup before and after work, ensuring no unrelated areas are captured.

10.Unpack and review the technical specifications of the IoT sensor (form factor, power requirements) before installation.

11.Remove the existing nozomi sensor (server), disconnect all cables, and hand it over to the Client’s team.

12.Tag and label all installed hardware, power supplies, and wiring as instructed, using provided tags and labels.

13.Install new hardware for Microsoft IoT sensors, including rack mounting and connecting cables (power, network, earthing).

14.Record the MAC address and serial number of the new IoT sensor.

15.Verify all network configurations and network traffic. Confidential-Third Party 16.Complete and submit the asset information form, including details such as MAC address, serial number, model, and default credentials for all hardware.

17.Configure management IP to enable remote connectivity for Wipro’s team.

18.Participate in interface meetings with the Wipro/Kenvue team.


Who Can Apply:

  • IT Support Engineers / Technicians / Consultants with hands-on experience in hardware installation, networking, and onsite client coordination.
  • Must be able to carry necessary tools to perform the work.
  • Should have strong knowledge of rack mounting, cabling, and IoT/network device installation.


About Teceze:

We are a global IT services company delivering managed services, IT support, cybersecurity, and project-based IT deployments for enterprise clients across multiple regions.


How to Apply:

If you are interested in this short-term onsite project, kindly share your updated profile with availability at (Insert Teceze Contact Email/Job Application Link) .

title: Instructional Designer
description:
ADP is hiring a Learning Design Consultant (Instructional Designer).


In this role, you will focus primarily on applying efficient and agile design approaches to develop innovative, engaging learning solutions, using ADP learning design standards and tools, to meet the learning needs of ADP associates and clients.


No two days are the same. You will do everything from creating design documents, testing and deploying content, conducting needs assessments across multiple business lines, establishing training plans, overseeing translations, measuring results, and more. You will do this all to the highest standards with an eye on appealing to multi-generational talent and the modern learner and by partnering across the learning organization to apply innovative techniques in instructional design. You can create compelling content and convey ideas and information to many levels of an organization.


To thrive in the role, you have 3+ years of experience in the learning - development field. You have worked independently to design and develop sound training in various modalities, i.E., eLearning, instructor-led, blended, job aids, and more, and can manage simultaneous projects with deadlines. It would be best to be a continuous learner who focuses on personal development and business process improvement to our design standards. Your work will help our businesses support our clients who employ one to millions of employees.


Like what you see? Apply now!


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Innovation : You seek opportunities to apply innovative design thinking to your projects and will work to keep ADP's approach to designing learning up to date with the products and solutions ADP offers its clients.
  • Flexibility and Agility : You can adapt to changing business requirements, projects, and resources and use agile approaches to meet business needs.
  • Design: You'll design holistic solutions engaging team members and business partners in the design process to ensure the solution design is flexible and addresses the unique needs of the learners. Solution design should consider and factor in how the work environment impacts learning.
  • Development: You can develop solutions across a broad set of learning modalities and tools without creating redundant solutions and ensure that continuous learning and performance support concepts are applied.
  • Learning Outcomes: You measure your outcomes and ensure your learning solutions result in the intended business impact.
  • Continuous Learner: You focus on personal development to develop and elevate professional knowledge and skill. You take the same approach to business process improvement to improve ADP learning design standards and drive the adoption of those standards. You maintain an outside-in perspective by building and maintaining peer networks inside and outside ADP.


TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

A college degree is not required but could set you apart. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job. You will need 3+ years of experience in instructional development, adult learning theory, and/or technical writing.

Other things that will set you apart:

  • Experience using eLearning tools such as Captivate, Articulate 360 , Synthesia, TechSmith Camtasia , TechSmith SnagIt, Audacity, and Vyond. Technical aptitude to quickly learn new development tools.
  • Experience using a Learning Management System (i.E., Litmos)
  • Experience with simple Graphic Design


Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in the learning and development field
  • Ability to systematically design, develop, and implement learning content that meets specific organizational needs
  • Skilled in building learning solutions for English-speaking audiences
  • Proficient in Articulate Storyline, Rise, Synthesia, or similar authoring tools
  • Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (upload/manage content, apply technical standards, etc.)
  • Proven success collaborating virtually


YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Collaborate. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner - doer. Mission-driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

title: Cabotage Coordinator
description:
Cabotage Coordinator

Job Title: Cabotage Coordinator

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Terms: Full Time. On site.

Compensation: Commensurate with experience, the individual’s, and the team’s performance.

Company:

Sky Fusion Global Supply Chain focus on global dry bulk shipping and Industrial Projects Logistics. Headquartered in Singapore, we have settled filiales in China, Morocco, South Africa, Australia, Brazil, USA, Germany, and continues to be a globally expanding group.


Our Core Business:

  • Global Dry Bulk Freight
  • Industrial Projects Logistics & Renewable Energy Supply Chain Innovation


For more information, you may check our website：


Role

Sky Fusion is seeking the right candidate to fill a key role, the new Cabotage Coordinator. The primary focus of this role is the coordination of bids for Brazilian Flag impelled cargo opportunities. These are cargoes that will move within the Brazilian territory.

The coordinator will be tasked with evaluating and pursuing both commercial and operational cargoes for carriage on the Company’s Brazil Flag vessels. The scope of these cargo bids may often require extension of the scope to include use of multimodal forms of conveyance.

Candidates are encouraged to think outside of the box. There are always new challenges on the horizon and ways to improve, even in a business as old as shipping.

This position will challenge the coordinator to come up with creative solutions by matching multiple fleet schedules and modes of transportation with various bids. This role will require constant interaction and communication with the Client’s team to ensure the successful execution of projects.


Responsibilities & Duties

a. Identification and pursuit of chartering opportunities for wind projects.

b. Voyage calculations and pricing of both near‐term and long‐term project cargoes.

c. Analysis of intermodal bids (commercial).

d. Administration of quoting system. Emphasis on visibility within team and timely communications with

customers.

e. Project monitoring

f. Tracking Wind Cargo Flows (Historic & Projected)


Requirements & Skills

a. Ability to multi‐task

b. Understanding of terms and conditions for contracts of carriage and carriage of breakbulk cargoes under Brazilian Cabotage legistlation.

c. Strong verbal and written communication skills

d. Attention to detail.

e. Minimum of bachelor’s degree (preferably in a Maritime Business Administration or Transportation).

f. Minimum three (3) years of experience in the Fluvial / Caoastal cabotage transportation industry is preferred but candidates with les experience will still receive consideration.


Personal Characteristics

Ambitious | Enthusiastic | Team player

title: Gerente Sr. Em Relações Sindicais
description:
Somos PepsiCo


Junte-se à PepsiCo e Ouse Transformar! Somos o lugar perfeito para pessoas curiosas, pensadoras e agentes de mudança. Desde o frontline até a nossa liderança, estamos entusiasmados(as) com o futuro e trabalhamos em equipe para tornar o mundo um lugar melhor.


Fazer parte da PepsiCo significa fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de alimentos e bebidas do mundo, com nossas marcas icônicas sendo consumidas mais de um bilhão de vezes por dia em mais de 200 países. No Brasil desde 1953, a PepsiCo possui marcas reconhecidas como QUAKER®, TODDY®, TODDYNHO®, ELMA CHIPS®, RUFFLES®, DORITOS®, EQLIBRI ™, GATORADE®, KERO COCO®, H2OH!®, PEPSI® e muitas outras.


Uma carreira na PepsiCo significa trabalhar em uma cultura onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas. Aqui, você pode ousar ser você. Não importa quem você seja, de onde você venha ou quem você ame, você sempre pode influenciar as pessoas ao seu redor e causar um impacto positivo no mundo.


Conheça um pouco mais sobre a PepsiCo: PepsiCoJobs


A Oportunidade


O Gerente Sr. de Relações Sindicais desempenha um papel crucial na definição e execução da estratégia de relações sindicais da PepsiCo do Brasil Foods. Esse cargo é responsável por desenvolver uma estrutura abrangente que esteja alinhada aos objetivos operacionais e à força de trabalho da PepsiCo do Brasil Foods, garantindo uma abordagem proativa e estratégica em relações sindicais. Atuando como principal negociador em negociações coletivas e interações com Conselhos de Trabalho, Sindicatos e representantes dos empregados, o Diretor de Relações Trabalhistas representa os interesses da PBF enquanto promove relações produtivas e positivas.


Sindicatos e empregados sindicalizados:Gerenciar relações com aprox. 80 sindicatos e conduzir mais de 330 negociações, representando 100% dos empregados sindicalizados, de forma a gerenciar eficazmente os processos de negociação coletiva. Melhorar as relações com o Ministério do Trabalho e outras autoridades.


Seu impacto


Negociação com sindicatos de Vendedores, Comércio, Motoristas e Operações (~150/ano);

Elaboração de relatórios gerenciais relacionados a todas as negociações coletivas;

Relacionamento com o Ministério do Trabalho e com os principais líderes sindicais, a fim de garantir negociações coletivas eficazes.


Quem estamos buscando?


  • Ensino Superior completa em Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida vivência com relações sindicais e negociações.
  • Inglês/espanhol - diferencial
  • Excelente habilidade analítica e organizacional, incluindo definição de prioridades e tomada de decisões;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Capacidade de iniciativa e de priorizar a carga de trabalho, sendo capaz de entregar resultados sob pressão e dentro de prazos definidos;
  • Trabalho em equipe, com habilidade para liderar e influenciar.


Se esta oportunidade for do seu interesse, incentivamos que se candidate, mesmo que não atenda 100% dos requisitos.


O que você pode esperar da gente?


Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:

  • Remuneração competitiva, com componentes fixos e variáveis que permitirão alcançar suas metas financeiras.
  • Um programa de flexibilidade que permitirá equilibrar melhor sua vida pessoal e profissional, adaptando seu horário de trabalho ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Benefícios como seguros, telemedicina e check-up médico, para que você se mantenha sempre em seu melhor estado de saúde.
  • Com nosso benefício de Auto Executivo, você poderá escolher entre um carro, que inclui também ajuda com combustível e manutenção;
    ou um bônus de auxílio transporte (apenas para níveis gerenciais L10+).
  • Um programa de bem, com diferentes iniciativas ao longo do ano, que ajudará a promover mais equilíbri o para a sua saúde física, mental e integral -.
  • Programas que ajudarão a cuidar do seu bem-estar financeiro e a alcançar suas metas em todas as etapas da sua vida: Programa de Bem-Estar Financeiro, Caixa de Poupança, Fundo de Poupança e Previdência Privada.

title: Financial Controller - Latam
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.
As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!
At Palo Alto Networks, we believe in the power of collaboration and value in-person interactions. This is why our employees generally work full time from our office with flexibility offered where needed. This setup fosters casual conversations, problem-solving, and trusted relationships. Our goal is to create an environment where we all win with precision.
Job Description
Your Career
Palo Alto Networks has an exciting opportunity for a LatAm Controller to join our Finance Team. We are looking for a financial professional interested in a senior level opportunity as a regional Controller to ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting and financial reporting for the Palo Alto Networks legal entities in the Latin American region and play a key role in re-engineering processes to drive improvement. This position has extensive interaction with cross-functional business partners at all levels, including senior management in multiple geographical locations.
A successful candidate will be proactive, confident and solution-oriented, have a broad set of work experiences within a Finance organization, and will provide a strong voice to represent Finance throughout the Controllership to arrive at solutions all cross-functional groups will find reasonable.
Your Impact
  • Identify actionable insights and drive cross-functional process improvements including, but not limited to, internal and external financial reporting, regulatory compliance, internal controls and system integration in the region
  • Lead the formulation of the Country Controlling strategy for the region to align with business needs and corporate strategy
  • Take ownership of facilitation and creation of accurate project plans with clearly defined milestones, deliverables and tasks
  • Perform monthly detailed reviews of the regional financial statements to ensure alignment with corporate reporting and local accounting GAAP reporting requirements
  • Perform month-end close for the regional entities to ensure accurate US GAAP and company policy compliant financial statements, including reviewing monthly transactions, account reconciliations, and balance sheet and income statements for reasonableness
  • Effectively provide guidance and support to GL resources in the Palo Alto Networks Center of Excellence to improve the quality, timeliness and efficiency of the regional month-end close process
  • Coordinate with IT, global and regional accounting functions, and regional third-party accounting service providers on regional system implementation projects
  • Establish effective partnerships with Palo Alto Networks Global Process Owners, Centers of Excellence and corporate and regional accounting teams to drive the incorporation of global process standards in the region
  • Establish and document all policies, process and procedures localization requirements for the region
  • Effectively manage third-party service providers in region to improve the quality, timeliness and efficiency of their services
  • Coordinate annual statutory audits for various entities in region
  • Review and approve non-routine transactions in the regional entities
  • Ensure controls and discipline are in place to achieve high employee satisfaction within the region
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives in region
  • Ensure local compliance with regional regulations, regulatory filings, and accounting rules (GAAP)
  • Effectively partner with regional and corporate FP&A and People teams to provide accounting insight and support on regional matters
  • Work with cross-functional teams on treasury and tax strategies to support compliance and the corporate goals for the region
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • At least 8-12 years of relevant experience in a medium to large size international reporting environment is required and working experience in high tech companies with prior Big 4 accounting firm experience is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s in accounting or finance – Contador or equivalent certification a plus
  • In-depth expertise, excellent working ability, and knowledge of local GAAP accounting principles, regulatory compliance and reporting requirements
  • Hands-on experience managing the accounting and financial reporting processes for international operations in the Latin American region
  • Experience with SAP or other large ERP systems
  • Proficient in US accounting standards, principles and pronouncements
  • Proven ability to work in fast-paced environments, meet challenging deadlines and priorities, deliver on multiple simultaneous projects and drive changes
  • Problem solver with strong critical thinking and project management skills
  • Demonstrated judgment in prioritizing work, identifying issues and recommending solutions, and managing multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Fluent in English, fluent in Spanish or Portuguese a plus
  • Highly collaborative with a leadership attitude to take initiative to solve problems
  • Highly proficient in Excel and Google Sheets
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively, including cross-functionally
Please submit your resume in English only so that it can be properly evaluated by the Hiring team. Resumes in other languages, including Portuguese and Spanish, will not be considered for the open role.
 Additional Information
The Team
You have a passion for numbers & integration, our organization has a passion for cybersecurity. You’re looking for a career with a more fulfilling mission. We have open positions to top talent seeking a financial challenge. Our accounting department deals with numbers daily, supporting infrastructure, dealing in automation, building solutions and providing accurate, insightful financial information to empower our business lines. The ideal candidate has exceptional skills in accounting and analytics and an innovative mindset to approach finance problems differently. Our innovation doesn’t stay in Research and Development. Within finance and accounting, we seek people who are looking to try new things, while solving business critical equations. If you’re seeking a financial challenge but with a world-wide impact – this is it.

title: Especialista De Experiência Do Cliente
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.


Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.


Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Conhecer e realizar análise de base de NPS e CSAT;

- Realizar análises e estudos de bases com indicadores de impacto para identificar as principais dores dos alunos (B2C) e clientes (B2B), promovendo reuniões com os sponsors dos temas, acompanhamento de correção na causa raiz e validação da implantação com foco na experiência do aluno;

- Realizar estudos dos relatórios sobre os temas críticos e análises de melhoria para endereçar a área responsável pelo tema para correção proativa;

- Propor melhorias em processos já existentes voltado a otimização e eficácia com foco na experiência;

- Realizar reports semanais do andamento das suas atividades.

- Elaborar materiais em Power point para apresentações executivas;

- Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes multifuncionais para avaliar a jornada do aluno em implantações de projetos, tanto conduzido pela gerência sênior de Service Design como das demais áreas da companhia, para avaliação de impacto, fluidez e clareza nas comunicações;

- Acompanhar os indicadores de impacto sazonais e identificar oportunidade na experiência.

- Demonstrar proatividade e adaptabilidade para lidar com situações imprevistas.

- Ser resiliente e capaz de superar desafios para garantir o sucesso dos alunos.

- Realizar mapeamento de jornadas com os principais touchpoint, passo a passo dos nossos alunos (B2C) e clientes (B2B).

Requisitos e qualificações:

- Ensino superior completo;

- Experiência em mapeamento de processos e jornada;

- Ter conhecimento intermediário com Bizagi ou Visio para desenhos de fluxograma;

- Conhecimento emmetodologia ágil;

- Conhecimento avançado em apresentações executivas;

- Vivência na área de experiência e condução em melhoria de jornada;

- Experiência comanálises em NPS e CSAT;

- Experiência em análise se processos/dores e propor melhorias;

- Ter conhecimento intermediário na ferramenta Miro.

Informações adicionais:

Modelo de trabalho híbrido (3x na semana presenciais);

Temos alguns escritórios espalhados pelo Brasil, mas você ficará alocado em São Paulo (Av. Paulista).


O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.



Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Assistente De Manutenção
description:
Resumo das atividades


Foco em Manutenção Residencial .

  • Executar manutenção corretiva elétrica, mecânica e hidráulica em máquinas, equipamentos e instalações, atendendo solicitações internas e de moradores, diagnosticando defeitos, através de manuais, desenhos e/ou avaliação técnica, substituindo peças e efetuando os ajustes necessários;
  • Realizar manutenção preventiva (mecânica, elétrica e hidráulica) baseando-se em checklist, inspecionando equipamentos de sistemas de refrigeração, funcionamento de bombas, caixa d’água, parte elétrica, geradores etc., detectando possíveis irregularidades, executando os reparos e informando o superior sobre os problemas detectados;
  • Utilizar, ferramentas e equipamentos apropriados para cada tipo de atividade, inclusive trabalhos em altura, fazendo uso dos acessórios de segurança exigidos, conforme legislação vigente;
  • Cuidar da segurança dos usuários, residentes e funcionários, durante a execução dos serviços de manutenção;
  • Prestar suportetécnico aos moradores e demais usuários, realizando manutenção corretiva/preventiva nos apartamentos;
  • Acompanhar leitura e registrar o consumo diário de gás, água e energia;
  • Inspecionar os equipamentos de combate a incêndio;
  • Solicitar e acompanhar visita técnica e manutenção realizada por terceiros;
  • Cumprir procedimentos relativos ao uso de EPI e EPC;
  • Zelar pela conservação dos materiais, ferramentas e equipamentos utilizados nos serviços de manutenção, requisitando sua reposição quando necessário;
  • Orientar profissionais de menor nível de experiência assim como fornecedores;
  • Executar pequenos serviços de alvenaria e marcenaria, quando necessário;
  • Registrar as manutenções efetuadas e todos os atendimentos realizados a moradores;
  • Executar outrasatribuições correlatas de acordo com a necessidade da área;
  • Liderar e coordenar equipe de brigadistas, realizar ações de treinamento e procedimentos para o Edifício.
  • Controlar o estoque de materiais, peças, componentes, ferramentas e equipamentos, verificando quantidades e registrando em documentos e planilhas sua movimentação;


Qualificação

Ensino médio completo;

Desejável superior ou técnico em elétrica, refrigeração, mecânica, hidráulica;

Curso de NR10.


Habilidades

Capacidade resolutiva;

Comunicar-se de forma inclusiva e eficaz diante um público multicultural e amplamente conectado;

Organização para arquivar informações de maneira correta;

Proatividade em executar as manutenções.


Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Vale-refeição
  • Vale-transporte


Horário de trabalho:


  • De segunda à sexta-feira

title: Analista De Equipamentos E Automação

Os clientes incluem quase todos os fabricantes de automóveis na Europa, América do Norte e do Sul, Ásia e África. A Autoneum possui 77 instalações e emprega cerca de 16.500 pessoas em todo o mundo. A empresa com sede em Winterthur, Suíça, está listada na SIX Swiss Exchange (símbolo AUTN).


Estamos procurando por:

Cargo: Analista de Equipamentos e Automação.

Área de atuação: Engenharia de Processos

Local de trabalho: Jardim Guairacá, São Paulo - SP - Presencial.

E-mail:

Requisitos mandatórios:

  • Formação: Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Mecatrônica, Tecnólogo em Mecatrônica ou Automação de Processos;
  • Idioma: Inglês avançado (necessário para interação com especialistas da Autoneum Global e fornecedores);
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 5 anos de atuação em ambiente industrial.
  • Disponibilidade: para viagens nacionais e internacionais e CNH válida.


Conhecimentos:

  • Indústria automotiva.
  • Programação de robôs FANUC .
  • Automação e lógica de programação.
  • Metodologias de análise e solução de problemas (5 Porquês, Pareto, Ishikawa, PDCA, DMAIC, etc.).
  • Desenho técnico.
  • Softwares de CAD .
  • Ferramentas de gestão da qualidade (FMEA, MASP).
  • Conceitos e práticas de Lean Manufacturing .


Você pode se destacar se tiver:

  • Norma IATF 16949;
  • Programação de Robô FANUC e sistemas de alta pressão;
  • Power BI;
  • Formação em Green Belt/Black Belt.

title: Senior Consultant – Global Transaction Banking
description:
Join NFQ!


We are a global consulting firm specialized in business, technology, and operations, with over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices. At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Client-Centric .


As part of our continuous growth, we are looking for an experienced Senior Consultant with strong expertise in Global Transaction Banking (GTB) to join our team in São Paulo (Hybrid model).


If you are passionate about corporate banking solutions , trade finance , and cash management , and want to lead impactful transformation projects in the financial industry, this opportunity is for you.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead gap analysis, requirements gathering, and validation to define practical solutions and perform comparative assessments with a strategic focus on Global Transaction Banking (GTB) .
  • Drive and support initiatives in:
  • Trade Finance & Working Capital (Documentary Trade, Factoring/Receivables Finance, Supply Chain Finance/Confirming, Export & Agency Finance, Structured Trade).
  • Cash Management (cash pooling, sweeping, virtual accounts, liquidity dashboards).
  • Plan, oversee, and coordinate project deliverables within defined time and cost parameters .
  • Prepare and deliver project reporting to senior management through presentations and executive updates.
  • Coordinate workshops and meetings with internal and external stakeholders for strategic alignment and requirements validation.
  • Define and execute testing initiatives in collaboration with IT teams.
  • Ensure alignment and coordination between Business, IT, Operations, Risk, and other stakeholders to meet client needs.
  • Support change management and successful adoption of new systems or processes.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Knowledge of PIX (Brazilian instant payments): rules, reconciliation, and immediate settlement.
  • Understanding of Brazilian regulations (BACEN: PIX, TED, DOC) and international trade finance standards .
  • Proven experience participating in the implementation of PIX (Brazil’s instant payment system) , including setup, rules, reconciliation, and immediate settlement.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial consulting, institutional or corporate banking , or related sectors.
  • Hands-on expertise in Global Transaction Banking (GTB) with working knowledge in at least one of the following:
  • Trade Finance & Working Capital (Documentary Trade, Supply Chain Finance, Receivables Finance).
  • Cash Management (payments, liquidity, pooling, virtual accounts).
  • Proven skills in requirements gathering, senior-level reporting, IT liaison, and testing .
  • Familiarity with corporate banking platforms such as Finastra, Temenos, Oracle Flexcube, Kyriba, or similar.
  • Experience with digital and API-based GTB solutions .
  • Fluent English (written and spoken).
  • Spanish is a strong plus.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with ERP / Treasury Management Systems (TMS) such as SAP Treasury, Kyriba, Oracle Treasury, or Finastra.
  • Familiarity with process automation (RPA) and liquidity dashboards (Power BI, Tableau).
  • Experience in operational and liquidity risk management .
  • Exposure to cross-border payments, FX, and international trade finance projects .
  • Proficiency in agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), workshop facilitation, and requirements discovery.
  • Relevant certifications such as CPA-20, CTP, CFA ;
    graduate degrees (Master’s or specialization) in Finance, Economics, International Business, or Risk Management.


Preferred Education

  • Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Banking, Accounting, Engineering (Industrial, Systems, Production) — strong foundation in corporate finance, trade finance, and process optimization.
  • Advanced education (Master’s level or specialization) highly valued:
  • Master’s in Finance, Economics, or International Business.
  • MBA focused on strategic management and stakeholder engagement.
  • Postgraduate degrees in Banking, Treasury, or Risk Management.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to lead strategic GTB transformation projects for top-tier financial institutions.
  • Work in a dynamic and international environment with exposure to high-impact banking initiatives.
  • Continuous learning, certifications, and professional development plans .
  • Language classes to boost your global career.
  • Flexible work model (Hybrid – São Paulo).


CLT contract benefits:

  • Health & dental insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Meal voucher
  • Transportation allowance
  • VR - R$ 800,00
  • A collaborative work environment, internal events, and global mobility opportunities.


Learn more about us: nfq.Es | LinkedIn NFQ

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)


Ready to lead GTB transformation and make an impact in corporate banking? Apply now!

title: Analista De Planejamento Financeiro Pleno
description:
Quem somos


A BIOTRONIK é uma empresa de dispositivos médicos que tem em seu DNA o pioneirismo e a inovação. Há 40 anos no Brasil, contribuímos para melhorar a vida de milhões de pacientes todos os dias. Estamos presentes em mais de 100 países, exercendo a missão de combinar com perfeição a tecnologia com o corpo humano para promover assim, a saúde e o bem-estar para todas as pessoas.

Nosso lema é oferecer Excelência para Vida!


Já pensou fazer parte do nosso propósito? “Um segundo. Uma Vida”! Esta é a nossa visão!


Descrição do trabalho


Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Planejamento Financeiro para atuar de forma estratégica na companhia. Esse(a) profissional será responsável por mensurar, acompanhar e comunicar às áreas internas o desempenho econômico-financeiro, com base na análise dos resultados corporativos, assegurando a execução da estratégia definida. Além disso, terá papel fundamental no fornecimento de informações gerenciais que permitam antecipar riscos e identificar oportunidades, apoiando a tomada de decisão e contribuindo para o crescimento sustentável do negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar a consolidação e análise econômica e financeira do P&L completo da América Latina e comparar com demais cenários;
  • Elaborar, analisar e divulgar relatórios financeiros para assessorar a companhia, fornecendo maior visibilidade e auxiliar à tomada de decisão;
  • Elaborar processo de revisão mensal de Vendas e Resultado, LBE (Latest Best Estimate), (Actual x Budget x LBE);
  • Elaborar os relatórios e apresentações dos resultados vs orçamento e revisões com análises quantitativas e qualitativas das variações;
  • Elaborar indicadores mensais das áreas e apresentá-los sempre que necessário;
  • Propor alternativas de melhoria nos processos da área com o objetivo de otimizar o tempo e processos;
  • Formalizar os processos da área e divulgar às áreas relacionadas para que cumpram prazos e políticas;
  • Manter as plataformas da empresa atualizadas de acordo com a necessidade e diretrizes de Compliance;
  • Exercer demais atividades relacionadas à função de acordo com a necessidade da empresa.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior Completo em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis ou Engenharia;

Com mais de 5 milhões de clientes ativos e grande relevância na área do varejo, disponibilizamos um amplo portfólio de serviços para pessoas físicas e jurídicas, além de um Banking as a Service (BaaS) para marcas de diversos segmentos. title: Senior Business Continuity Analyst
description:
Purpose of the Position

An Asian financial institution, recognized as one of the largest and among the leading banks worldwide, with a strong presence across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. In Brazil, the institution focuses on corporate and investment banking, providing clients with tailored financial solutions.


With a global reputation for stability and long-term relationships, the institution continues to invest in innovation, cybersecurity, and sustainability, reinforcing its commitment to responsible growth and the protection of client interests in a rapidly evolving financial landscape.


The main idea of this role is to protect the institution’s ability to deliver critical banking services during disruption by owning and advancing the BCM – Business Continuity Management program processes. This is a hands-on, orchestration-heavy position that translates global continuity standards into effective local execution and audit-ready evidence.

Concretely, the role:

  • Leads the BCM lifecycle end-to-end: conducts BIAs (criticality, dependencies, RTO/RPO), maintains BCPs, and plans/coordinates tests (e.G., DR/switch-over validations, contingency site, VDI/endpoint readiness, evacuation drills, call tree), including out-of-hours windows.
  • Turns results into decisions: surfaces risks, residual exposures, and disclaimers to risk committees;
    drives lessons learned and closes open issues with robust documentation and owners/dates/evidence.
  • Connects BCM to the broader non-financial risk picture: interfaces with Operational Incidents, Vendor Risk, Products & Services, and RCSA so that continuity risks and control gaps are consistently identified, tracked, and remediated.
  • Bridges global and local: adapts global policy/standards to Brazil’s context, ensuring regulatory fit (BACEN) without diluting control integrity.
  • Influences without formal authority: engages senior stakeholders (e.G., Treasury and Operations leaders) to prioritize continuity activities, align on test windows, and validate outcomes;
    partners with IT/IS to validate DR without performing technical changes.


Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Operate the existing Business Continuity framework while continuously improving its maturity, expanding coverage, and strengthening evidence quality.
  • Organize and document activities using spreadsheets and manual controls, ensuring that all records are audit-ready and compliant with internal and external requirements.
  • Plan, coordinate, and lead continuity tests, including out-of-hours exercises, anticipating risks, resolving issues on the spot, and making sound, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Adapt global policies and methodologies to the Brazilian regulatory context, maintaining alignment with global standards and full compliance with BACEN requirements.
  • Engage and influence critical business areas, such as Treasury and Operations, to secure collaboration and prioritization of BCM activities without direct authority.
  • Map critical processes, conduct Business Impact Analyses (BIA), and maintain updated Business Continuity Plans (BCP).
  • Develop, update, and review continuity policies, standards, and procedures, while supporting the management of open issues, regulatory requirements, and action plans.
  • Deliver training to teams and managers on continuity and disaster recovery procedures, proactively monitor external events and news for potential risks
  • This role will also involve executing other operational risk programs such as Operational Incident Management, Vendor/Product & Service Risk Management, etc.


Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Bring solid experience gained over several years in financial institutions, with a proven track record in Business Continuity Management, including BIA, BCP, and continuity testing.
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of operational resilience practices, with exposure to RCSA, operational incident management, and vendor/third-party risk.
  • Be comfortable coordinating with IT and Information Security (IS) teams during disaster recovery validations, leading and validating outcomes without performing the technical execution.
  • Possess proficiency in Excel for data analysis and tracking, and PowerPoint for building clear, executive-level presentations and reports.
  • Communicate effectively in English at a level to interact with global stakeholders and follow corporate standards.
  • Hold a degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems/Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of Bank Policies and Regulations, familiarity with cyber risk policies, procedures, and regulations, and the ability to review and ensure compliance with these requirements (Differential). Bring additional exposure to ISO 22301 standards, experience with tools such as Visio or Power BI/Power Query, and professional certifications in business continuity or disaster recovery (e.G., CBCP, DRII, BRCCI). (Differential)


Behavioral Skills

  • Executive communication & influence – Engages effectively with senior stakeholders, articulates complex topics in a clear, concise manner, and secures alignment in risk committees.
  • Proactivity & ownership – Demonstrates a self-starter mindset, acting hands-on and taking full responsibility for driving initiatives to completion.
  • Organization, discipline & critical thinking – Maintains audit-ready documentation with rigor and structure, while applying analytical thinking and sound judgment to make timely, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Collaboration & resilience – Partners seamlessly with Non-Tech areas and IT/IS, showing adaptability and composure under pressure, and adjusting course when unexpected challenges arise.

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - Latam
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone.
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional.

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others.

Who you are

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package
  • Paid Time Off
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate’s education, experience, skills and potential.
Hunter Douglas is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with applicable employment laws. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled are encouraged to apply.

description:

Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento (P&D): Conduzir análises exploratórias complexas e desenvolver modelos preditivos e prescritivos para resolver desafios de negócio, desde a otimização de processos até a criação de novos produtos.

Governança de IA e MLOps: Definir, implantar e operacionalizar a governança para todo o ciclo de vida de projetos de Ciência de Dados em ambiente cloud, incluindo a implementação de esteiras de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e versionamento de modelos.

Liderança Técnica e Mentoria: Atuar como referência técnica para a equipe, fornecendo suporte a outros cientistas e engenheiros de dados, disseminando conhecimento e garantindo a aplicação das melhores práticas e padrões de desenvolvimento.

Arquitetura de Soluções de Dados: Projetar e documentar a arquitetura de soluções de IA configurando ambientes e ferramentas em cloud (preferencialmente Azure) e produzindo templates e aceleradores para otimizar a entrega de projetos.

Colaboração com Stakeholders: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as áreas de negócio para entender suas necessidades, traduzir requisitos em especificações técnicas e apresentar os resultados e o valor gerado pelas soluções de forma clara e executiva.

Inovação Contínua: Avaliar e testar novas tecnologias, frameworks e tendências do mercado de IA (ex: Deep Learning, Processamento de Linguagem Natural, Análise de dados de IoT) para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e inovação.


Competências Técnicas :


Linguagens e Ferramentas: Proficiência em Python e/ou R para análise e modelagem de dados.

title: Desenvolvedor(A) Gis
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. title: Especialista Em Dados
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços TI do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira! Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.


Sobre o Papel:

Procuramos Administrador de Dados - Especialista que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Modelagem de Dados: Projetar, desenvolver e manter modelos de dados relacionais e multidimensionais para atender a requisitos de sistemas transacionais (OLTP) e analíticos (OLAP/Data Warehouse).

Gestão de Metadados: Administrar o catálogo de dados, definindo conceitos de negócio, mantendo a linhagem da informação (data lineage) e assegurando que os metadados sejam claros e acessíveis.

Qualidade de Dados (Data Quality): Implementar e monitorar regras de qualidade de dados, identificar anomalias e colaborar com as equipes de negócio e desenvolvimento para corrigir inconsistências.

Governança de Dados: Apoiar na criação, curadoria e evolução de guias de boas práticas e padrões para modelagem e integração de dados, garantindo a conformidade com políticas internas e regulamentações como a LGPD.

Implementação e Curadoria: Criar e realizar a curadoria dos modelos físicos de dados nos bancos de dados, garantindo que a implementação esteja alinhada ao design lógico.

Colaboração Técnica: Atuar como ponto de referência para equipes de desenvolvimento, BI e ciência de dados, oferecendo suporte e expertise em questões relacionadas à estrutura e acesso aos dados


Competências Técnicas


Domínio avançado e estratégico de práticas de modelagem e arquitetura de dados, incluindo Data Vault e outros padrões modernos.

Experiência profunda e liderança técnica com ferramentas de modelagem (Oracle Data Modeler) e da suíte de governança Informatica (IDMC).

Capacidade de desenhar e implementar estratégias de governança de dados do zero, incluindo a definição de roadmaps e políticas de acordo com a LGPD e outras regulamentações.

Habilidade para atuar como mentor técnico, definindo e disseminando as melhores práticas de modelagem e qualidade de dados para outras equipes.

Sólida experiência com ecossistemas de Big Data e plataformas de dados em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).


Certificações (Desejável)

Certificação de nível avançado, como:

DAMA Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) - Nível Master.

Informatica Certified Specialist/Expert.

Certificações de Arquitetura de Dados em Cloud (ex: Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Solutions Architect).


Diferenciais


Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) aplicadas a projetos de dados (DataOps).

Conhecimento em outras ferramentas de governança de dados (ex: Collibra, Alation).

Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (AWS, Azure, GCP), especialmente com serviços de banco de dados e data lake.


Formação: Superior completa e comprovada em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.

Pós-Graduação/MBA: Pelo menos uma Pós-Graduação, MBA ou certificação de nível avançado/expert relacionada à Gestão, Arquitetura ou Governança de Dados.


Idiomas: Inglês avançado ou fluente para colaboração com equipes globais.



O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Oportunidades para trabalho fora do Brasil
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

title: Analista Fiscal Jr
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?


Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.


Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.


No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².


Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.


No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.


A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.


Como nosso Analista Fiscal, você irá:


  • Conhecimento sobre fato gerador de impostos indiretos: ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, PIS COFINS;
  • Análise de documentos fiscais: NFe, CTe NFSe;
  • Vivência em apuração de impostos;
  • Conhecimento sobre direito a crédito de impostos;
  • Conhecimento emobrigações acessórias: SPED ICMS/IPI, EFD Contribuições, DIRBI
  • Conhecimento em registro de notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Conhecimento sobre regras de carta de correção;
  • Experiência comsistema integrado, SAP ECC e Tax One será diferencial.


Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:


  • Formação em Administração, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência comprovada na área fiscal;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Microsoft Office (Work, PowerPoint e Excel);

  • Seguro de Vida
  • Refeição no Local
  • Transporte
  • Crédito Consignado
  • Ticket Mês Aniversário
